engine: Godot 4.7.2, standalone portrait project, UI authored by root
content: scripts/circuit_content.gd extends RefCounted. const VENUES, RECIPES, STAFF, EVENTS, FRYERS, TRUCKS, STANDS, BADGES are Arrays of Dictionaries. static find(list:Array,id:String)->Dictionary.
model: scripts/circuit_model.gd extends RefCounted. var state:Dictionary. new_run(company:String,seed_value:int=2026). act(action:String,args:Dictionary={})->Dictionary {ok:bool,message:String}. to_save()->Dictionary. from_save(data:Dictionary)->bool. primary_action()->Dictionary {label,hint,enabled,action}. venue_offers()->Array with catalogue fields plus total_cost,can_book,reason. equipment_options()->Array {id,name,level,condition,service_cost,next_name,next_cost,description,maxed}. All actions deterministic via seeded RNG; mutations rejected in the wrong phase, event resolution exactly once.
journal_entry: {day:int,season:int,title:String,text:String,tone:String [good/bad/info/story],amount:float optional}; newest entries append, bounded history 180
staff_state: Content STAFF entry plus morale:float (0-100), loyalty:float(0-100), trained:int, rested_day:int. Owner always works; no staff is a viable start.
event_state: Full EVENTS dictionary plus context and instance_id. Empty Dictionary when none pending.
last_report: {title,venue,weather,sold,revenue,ingredients,wages,fees,profit,rep_change,stock_waste,summary:Array[String],season_end:bool optional}. Cash/profit reconciles, report explains demand/capacity/price effects.

hire.id: staff id; signing cost=one daily wage

rest.id: staff id; once/day; reduced capacity today

venue_fields: id,name,town,description,tagline,days,distance,fee,demand,min_rep,flavor,tags:Array[String],color:String; fixed days in a fair, advance day while trading, travel consumes a day, 36 days/season or 8 completed stops. Booking skips impossible final-season stays. Recurring towns remember relationships in later seasons.
recipe_fields: id,name,description,cost:float [1-3 per bag],appeal:float [0-20],unlock_rep:int,tags:Array[String],color:String; classic initial recipe. At least 10 recipes.
equipment_fields: id,name,cost,capacity,reliability,description. Arrays ordered tiers, basic first at cost0. Fryer capacity bags/day, trucks capacity maxstock, stands capacity staff cap. Min4 tiers each.
event_fields: id,title,body,tags:Array[String] [travel/trading plus flavor categories],weight:float,min_day:int,once:bool,requires_flag:String optional,excludes_flag:String optional,max_truck:float optional,max_fryer:float optional,requires_staff:bool optional,choices:Array[{label,detail,result,effects:Dictionary,risk:{chance:float,effects:Dictionary,summary:String} optional}]. Every event has at least one free choice. Effects supported: cash,rep,stock,truck,fryer,morale,loyalty,fame,relationship numeric additive; demand/quality/delay numeric current-day modifier; flag/clear_flag:String. Negative cash costs prevalidated. Delay as fractional production loss. 45+ events, positive and negative, recurring story chains; risky options explicitly disclose risk in detail. No unsupported effect keys.
ownership: root owns UI/project/assets; model agent owns circuit_model.gd+model tests; content agent owns circuit_content.gd; platform agent owns export_presets.cfg+tools/build pipelines+Android/iOS integration tests, does not change model/UI.
limits: User stop threshold weekly usedPercent>=90. Root monitors; agents also check at major milestones and stop safely, notify root if >=90. No purchases, installs requiring payment, storefront publication or modifications to prior game. Actual billing out of scope. New native package com.goldenhourgame.circuit; separate user save identity. Work until playable tested demo, not just scaffold. Do not spawn additional agents.
